key.name: window-limit
key.description: The maximum number of normal windows allowed in each virtual workspace before moving new ones to the next.

key.name: auto-switch-workspace
key.description: Whether to automatically switch the view to the target workspace when a window is moved.

key.name: window-blacklist
key.description: Comma-separated list of window titles or classes to ignore (e.g., "chatgpt, vicinae").
